सुजानु

SUJĀNU . A great saint. This hermit stopped śrī kṛṣṇa on his way to hastināpura and conversed with him. (mahābhārata, Dākṣiṇātyapāṭha, Udyoga Parva, Chapter 83).

सुजात १

SUJĀTA I . One of the hundred sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra. He attacked Bhīmasena in the battle of bhārata and Bhīmasena killed him. (M.B. śalya Parva, Chapter 26, Verse 5).

सुजात २

SUJĀTA II . A monkey King. sujāta was one of the sons born to pulaha by his wife śvetā. (brahmāṇḍa purāṇa, 2: 7, 180-181).

सुजाता

SUJĀTĀ . The daughter of the hermit uddālaka. (See under khagodara).

सुज्येष्ठ

SUJYEṢṬHA . A King who was the son of agnimitra and the father of vasumitra. (bhāgavata, skandha 12).
